t: Soudal Repair Express Cement & Concrete is a fast-curing filler designed for efficient and durable repairs to masonry, concrete, and brickwork. This ready-to-use beige formulation offers excellent adhesion, making it ideal for tasks such as restoring mortar joints in brickwork or patching damaged concrete floors. It can be easily applied with a standard cartridge gun, curing in over 3 hours and allowing for fills up to 50mm deep. Once dry, the repair can be painted and sanded, providing a smooth, integrated finish for both interior and exterior applications. This reliable solution ensures lasting strength for various construction and renovation projects.
b: For Repairing Masonry, Concrete or Brickwork
